answer: Grading panels are chosen by verifiable random sortition weighted by established stake, seeded from the prior block, so no agent knows which seats it holds until the draw lands. Cheap clones carry zero draw weight: 1000 unestablished sybils never seat. The stake-weighting is the ferrous spine; the unpredictability is the velvet that cannot be pre-bought; each captured seat sends a ripple the honeypot audits flag. Attacker cost = lock a controlling ~51% of ALL established stake (tens of millions, held continuously) to bias one panel, versus ~0 marginal influence per added clone.
